mapper.select:
select match_record.*, match_record.delivery_address as deliveryAddress, supply.product_name as supplyProductName, purchase_demand.product_name as demandProductName, coalesce(supply.product_name, purchase_demand.product_name) as productName, responder.name as responseUserName, coalesce(supplier.name, case when match_record.demand_id is not null then responder.name end) as supplierName, coalesce(buyer.name, case when match_record.supply_id is not null then responder.name end) as buyerName, coalesce(supply.supplier_id, case when match_record.demand_id is not null then match_record.response_user_id end) as supplierId, coalesce(purchase_demand.buyer_id, case when match_record.supply_id is not null then match_record.response_user_id end) as buyerId from match_record left join supply on match_record.supply_id = supply.id left join purchase_demand on match_record.demand_id = purchase_demand.id left join user responder on match_record.response_user_id = responder.id left join user supplier on supply.supplier_id = supplier.id left join user buyer on purchase_demand.buyer_id = buyer.id
and match_record.status != '已隐藏' and match_record.response_user_id = #{responseUserId} and (match_record.response_user_id = #{relatedUserId} or supply.supplier_id = #{relatedUserId} or purchase_demand.buyer_id = #{relatedUserId}) and match_record.status = #{status} and (supply.product_name like concat('%', #{productName}, '%') or purchase_demand.product_name like concat('%', #{productName}, '%'))
order by match_record.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into match_record(supply_id, demand_id, response_user_id, quantity, unit, price, message, status, delivery_address, create_time) values (#{supplyId}, #{demandId}, #{responseUserId}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{price}, #{message}, #{status}, #{deliveryAddress}, #{createTime})
